_comment: Profile for the homelab target (profiles.py). Groups run as separate jobs: make gl-group G=<group> [SHARD=i/N]. group_a and group_b split glue.demo between them with no overlap; 'all' is every table (what make gl-scan does without a group). Claims go to DynamoDB (Floci here, reached at GL_AWS_ENDPOINT from the pods; real DynamoDB on AWS with no endpoint).
